# discord_invite (Resource)

Manages a Discord channel invite.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_id` (String) The channel ID to create the invite for.

### Optional

- `max_age` (Number) Duration of invite in seconds before expiry. 0 means never.
- `max_uses` (Number) Max number of uses. 0 means unlimited.
- `temporary` (Boolean) Whether this invite only grants temporary membership.
- `unique` (Boolean) Whether to guarantee a unique invite code.

### Read-Only

- `code` (String) The invite code.
- `id` (String) The invite code (same as `code`).
